template_data.headline_html: Ask these five before you pick a vehicle.

items.title: Who's buying your category?
items.sub: Research which vehicle your CO uses — not which vehicle is most popular online

items.title: What's your typical deal size?
items.sub: Under $250K: GSA MAS. $5M+ services: look at OASIS+.

items.title: Do you have past performance?
items.sub: SEWP V and CIO-SP4 require it upfront. GSA MAS does not.

items.title: When is the next on-ramp?
items.sub: GSA MAS is open year-round. Other vehicles have periodic windows — miss one and you wait.

items.title: Can you maintain two vehicles?
items.sub: Holding multiple vehicles doubles the admin. Most small shops start with one and grow.
